cacheEntries.definition: Exact L1 entry/payload snapshot IDs with post-read membership fence; shared IDs overlap, not physical/native bytes.

heapOwnerBinding.identityBoundary: snapshot and IDs in one target job; synchronous inspector callbacks only
heapOwnerBinding.definition: Numeric IDs bind exact selected cache objects to this file; no physical memory estimate.

census.definition: V8 snapshot node self_size, after snapshot GC; not retained/exclusive bytes or total native memory.

heapRetainers.definition: Node retained_size is dominator-owned V8 self_size; class retained sizes overlap. Not total native memory or production savings.
heapRetainers.privacy: String payloads, source text, filesystem names and edge/property names are omitted.
heapRetainers.retainerDefinition: Depth-one unique incoming parents; excludes weak edges, non-root shortcuts, root and the queried node. First essential edge type per parent; no edge names.

limitations: Independent private request-only hosts; no production worker, background or historical recovery claim.
Baseline is the same candidate bundle with one guarded historical cache-key intervention.
Unforced heap/PSS windows include transient allocations; no GC, profiler or total native residual estimate.
Eight controlled full-read display variants are a counterexample workload, not measured production frequency.
Exact raw-cache content fingerprints are inspected after the resource windows.
Cache snapshots force GC after every unforced resource window; exact V8 nodes do not establish native physical ownership or production savings.
